name: GemmCoordinate<K>
description: a chain of K multiply-accumulates from c_0 = 0 on one tensor-core instruction's exact semantics (FP32 accumulation), then that target's epilogue

semantics.description: the exact tensor-core instruction whose accumulator step the chain uses (verity.ml.circuits.silicon.instructions)

ir_definitions: GemmCoordinate_v2{K, DOT} (verity.ml.circuits.ops.gemm); vLLM Gemm_v1 (N per token row, Ampere mma) and Gemm_v2 (Hopper wgmma) are N of them

sources.label: verity.ml.circuits.targets.target (GemmCoordinate<K>); archive/AGENTS.md: the decision workload, B = 4096 K = 1536 (frozen 2026-09-22)

work_model.basis: K multiply-accumulates (an FMA is 2 ops); the bf16 epilogue conversion is not counted (views.native, the tables' N)
work_model.source: verity.ml.circuits.ops.gemm GemmCoordinate: K/16 tensor-core steps of 16 multiply-adds
work_model.bytes_basis: reads the coordinate's weight row w[K] at the operand datatype's width (BITS, benchmarks/census/datatypes.json); x[K] is shared by every coordinate of its row and y is one word, so neither is counted per coordinate (the batch-1 decode reading: GEMM streams its weights)
work_model.bytes_source: bench-spine's port definitions (verity_numerical.bench.templates): gemm-coordinate x[K], w[K] -> y

fidelity_notes.note: H100 BF16 models mma (sm90.mma.m16n8k16.bf16); vLLM's H100 BF16 GEMMs run wgmma (sm90.wgmma.m64n8k16.bf16). On the H100 the two write the same words on every captured input, NaN and infinities included, so the gap is in the name only; gemm-coordinate/k1536/sm90-wgmma-bf16 names the instruction production runs

sources.label: docs ontology, Presentation rules (fidelity notes); verity.ml.circuits.targets.target BF16_HOPPER

three H100 runs, two of wgmma (A from shared memory / registers) and one of mma.sync on a second H100: every word matches hopper_bf16_wgmma_k16's total step, 0 mismatches; the specials family identical word for word across the instructions; veritor's wgmma records replayed through mma.sync, 0 mismatches (verity/ml/circuits/ops/tests/test_wgmma_bf16.py)

stood_for_by.why: on the H100, wgmma BF16 writes exactly mma BF16's output words on every captured input, NaN and infinities included
stood_for_by.ruling: record the equivalence rather than duplicate cells; new real-K H100 BF16 cells use this subcircuit's id

name: AttentionHead<T,D>
description: FlashAttention forward, one query head at the last position over its KV head (FA2 on sm80-class mma, FA3 on Hopper wgmma); the key count T varies per input

verifier_evaluated.parts: the softmax: the running max, MUFU.EX2, the lane sums and rescaling, MUFU.RCP of the sum and the output cast (C-Flock's native tail on the public words)

verifier_evaluated.ruling: red-team-flock-3 granted attention on flock-ir-frame/v3 on condition that the headline footnotes this (handoff 20260926T1115Z), and the class-pin statement (one pin per key-count class, T 1–128, 129–256, 257–512) with condition CP7 (handoff 20260926T1340Z)
